d:
The Cavaliers defeated the Knicks, 115-107 tonight in New York. James Harden finished with a team-high 32 points along with 5 three pointers and 4 assists for the Cavaliers, while Donovan Mitchell tallied 23 points, 7 rebounds and 6 assists in the game. Jalen Brunson recorded 27 points, 5 assists and 3 rebounds. The Cavaliers improve their record to 6-6 with the win, while the Knicks fall to 6-5 for the season.
